symptom_description: A frozen counterfactual-benefit-trained multiscale Ctrl-World adapter achieved the best held-out mean L1 and beneficial fixed endpoints on all three paired seeds, but its use head abstained on every seed and the candidate narrowly missed terminal-interaction and horizon-slope gates. The next mechanism must convert positive counterfactual benefit into calibrated execution while assigning more learning credit to terminal and long-horizon rollout quality.
model_family: Ctrl-World action-conditioned spatiotemporal U-Net latent video diffusion with a frozen official backbone, trainable multiscale history side adapter, and selective counterfactual-benefit router

experiment_evidence.observed_failure: C3 had the best mean L1 and passed paired wins and action retention, but failed final-interaction L1, horizon slope, and routing calibration versus B3. Every fixed multiscale positive endpoint was beneficial, while mean use probability stayed near 0.393 and active rate was zero.
